_note: K2: movement tunables (src/coach/derive/movement, src/coach/metrics/movement, src/coach/detect/movement). docs/coach/mechanics.md.

reload._: A reload is exposed when a living enemy is within nearUnits (and visible from the eye when a map pack is loaded) or the clip holds more than fullShare of the magazine. Deaths while reloading: the victim's reloading flag on the row before the death. Costs in fights per instance: a death, a reload with an enemy near, a reload with more than half the magazine (and no enemy near).

caughtOut._: Deaths with the knife or a grenade in hand (row before the death). Not counted: a grenade thrown within throwGraceMs before the death toward the killer (view yaw within throwAimDeg of the killer).
